nodes.name: Campaign Slug
nodes.notes: Set campaign slug and report path to match ideas/<slug>/05-campaign-diagnostics.md. Mount repo ideas/ into n8n at /data/ideas/ or adjust path.

parameters.query:
SET search_path TO hermes_outreach;
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM outreach_sends WHERE campaign = $1) AS sent,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT send_id) FROM outreach_events WHERE campaign = $1 AND event = 'delivered') AS delivered,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT recipient) FROM outreach_events WHERE campaign = $1 AND event = 'opened' AND is_bot = false) AS opened_human,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT recipient) FROM outreach_events WHERE campaign = $1 AND event = 'clicked' AND is_bot = false) AS clicked,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM outreach_state WHERE campaign = $1 AND status = 'replied') AS replied,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM outreach_events WHERE campaign = $1 AND event = 'complained') AS complaints,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM outreach_state WHERE campaign = $1) AS enrolled,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM outreach_state WHERE campaign = $1 AND status = 'in_sequence') AS still_in_sequence;

SET search_path TO hermes_outreach;
SELECT recipient,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE event = 'opened' AND is_bot = false) AS opens,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE event = 'clicked' AND is_bot = false) AS clicks,
  max(occurred_at) AS last_event
FROM outreach_events
WHERE campaign = $1
GROUP BY recipient
HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE event = 'opened' AND is_bot = false) > 0
   AND count(*) FILTER (WHERE event = 'clicked' AND is_bot = false) = 0
ORDER BY opens DESC
LIMIT 50;
